rollouts.objective: Choose a full second-moment superoperator, reachable cone, or controlled block-power representation and formulate a finite-time mu-scale contraction that handles non-normal prefactors.
forbidden_methods: fixed-A one-epoch energy as the terminal certificate
replacing finite-time control by a bare asymptotic spectral-radius statement
required_controls: full Sym_n versus reachable rank-one covariance semantics
a noncommuting near-singular unit-diagonal SPD family
incomplete final blocks and expected-distance conversion

rollouts.objective: Construct an exchangeable-pair, adjacent-transposition coupling, or permutation martingale whose conditional variance gives a mu-scale RPCD contraction without reducing to the covariance-spectrum route.
forbidden_methods: black-box diagonalization of the full covariance superoperator
assuming independent coordinate samples within an epoch
using a scalar bounded-differences estimate with dimensional loss as if sharp
required_controls: fresh uniform permutation and without-replacement dependence
a family testing whether the variance proxy loses a factor n

rollouts.objective: Represent random Gauss-Seidel products by noncommutative polynomials, trace moments, or a resolvent hierarchy and seek a dimension-uniform moment certificate for finite-time expected distance.
forbidden_methods: treating trace control as operator-norm control without a dimension-free bridge
relabeling Bellman prefix inversion as a new moment method
required_controls: an equicorrelation control and an anisotropic noncommuting stress family

rollouts.objective: Search for a phase-, history-, or cone-dependent Lyapunov functional and its exact SDP/duality obstruction, rather than a single fixed-A one-step metric.
forbidden_methods: a single fixed-A one-epoch Lyapunov inequality
promoting a floating-point SDP optimum to a general certificate
assuming a common quadratic Lyapunov function must exist
required_controls: an exact finite-dimensional dual certificate or symbolic necessary condition
metric-comparison constants needed for expected A-distance
a stress test for dimension growth of the adaptive state
